title: Artichoke Nachos: Trimming, Steaming, Aioli, and Composting (BuzzFeed Nifty)

locations.name: Piedras Negras, Mexico
locations.basis: Transcript states nachos were invented in 1943 by Ignacio Anaya in Piedras Negras.

locations.name: Mount Olympus (mythological)
locations.basis: Transcript recounts Zeus turning a woman into an artichoke and taking her to Mount Olympus; not presented as filming location.

summary: In this BuzzFeed Nifty video, Ari repurposes artichoke scraps into a playful “nachos” dish while interleaving a sustainability moment. The episode covers trimming artichokes to reveal the edible heart, removing the choke, and steaming the petals and hearts; it then builds a toppings lineup (cilantro, serrano, garlic aioli, vegan feta with olives) and demonstrates a compost-focused sidetrack where artichoke scraps and the steaming liquid are blended and composted in a tumbler. The chef preheats the oven, assembles the “nachos” atop artichoke pieces, and bakes briefly before tasting, while noting nachos’ cultural origin (Piedras Negras, Mexico). The piece blends practical prep with a light environmental philosophy and a few playful mythic asides about artichokes.”
